Description: Lodestar AWS EC2 expiration enforcement, scoped to approved test Windows instances, scans every 15 minutes.

Properties.AlarmDescription: Lodestar expiration guard: Lambda scan or termination errors; email endpoint stored as masked stack parameter.

NotificationEmail.Description: Confirmed email endpoint for SNS notifications; masked when stack described.

LodestarVpcId.Description: Existing Lodestar test VPC; required for authorized deployment updates.

WindowsSecurityGroupId.Description: Existing Windows test security group; required for authorized deployment updates.
